'''League of Legends Championship Pacific 2025 Season Kickoff''' is the first Pacific League of Legends split under the LCP banner, with eight Pacific teams compete for the LCP title.

==Format==
* '''Regular Season'''
**Single Round Robin
**Each team plays 7 matches
**All matches are {{Abbr/Bo3}}
**Top 6 teams advance to the playoffs
* '''Playoffs'''
** All matches before Bracket Finals are {{Abbr/Bo3}} 
** All remaining matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}} 
** Champion qualifies for [[First Stand Tournament/2025|First Stand]]
* All matches are played under {{Abbr|Fearless Draft|No champion can be played more than once during the entire series.}} rules
